title: Agentic UI Frameworks
overview: 由于LLM从被动文本生成器向能够进行规划，工具使用，以及多步骤推理的主动Agent过渡，人类与之互动的界面必须同步演化。传统的聊天界面——为单回合或短文本对话设计——不适合Agent工作流程的要求:长期任务，分化决策树，并行工具引用，以及需要有意义的人监督。本节调查AgentUI框架的景观:设计范式，组件库，以及能够促成丰富，透明和可信赖的人力Agent协作的执行模式。

blocks.text: 阅读 §27.2「UI Paradigms for Agents」 时，区分 model 产生的决策、Harness 负责的执行、protocol 规定的消息边界，以及环境返回的 observation。把这些责任混在一起，会让权限、错误恢复和审计问题无法定位。
没有一个单一的UI范式适合所有Agent使用案例。 适当的接口取决于任务持续时间、需要的人的参与、产出类型和用户专业知识。谱面范围从完全对话聊天界面到完全自主的仪表板，人类互动最小。
blocks.originalExcerpt: No single UI paradigm suits all agentic use cases. The appropriate interface depends on task duration, required human involvement, output type, and user expertise. The spectrum ranges from fully conversational chat interfaces to fully autonomous dashboards with minimal human interaction.

blocks.text: Chat UI 限制Agent聊天接口将内在的并行进程序列化。当Agent转发到五个工具时，一个线性信息流会错误地反映实际执行图。对于复杂的Agent工作流程，应该用富人范式来增加聊天，或者用富人范式来取代聊天。
blocks.originalExcerpt: Chat UI Limitations for Agents Chat interfaces serialize inherently parallel processes. When an agent fans out to five tools simultaneously, a linear message stream misrepresents the actual execution graph. For complex agentic workflows, chat should be augmented with—or replaced by—richer paradigms.

由克劳德·阿尔蒂法克斯1和ChatGPT Canvas2所普及的画布范式引入了分页布局:左面板主控对话，而右面板(“canvas”或“artifact geater”)则显示生成的内容——代码、文档、图表、电子表格——作为活的、可编辑的文物。
blocks.originalExcerpt: The canvas paradigm, popularized by Claude Artifacts1 and ChatGPT Canvas,2 introduces a splitpane layout: the left pane hosts the conversation, while the right pane (the “canvas” or “artifact panel”) displays generated content—code, documents, diagrams, spreadsheets—as a live, editable artifact. Key characteristics:

blocks.text: • 长期文物:生成的内容长期存在，可以反复精细加工
blocks.originalExcerpt: • Persistent artifacts: Generated content persists across turns and can be iteratively refined

blocks.text: 通过自然语言说明(“使图表为蓝色”，“将错误处理添加到函数中”)。
blocks.originalExcerpt: through natural language instructions (“make the chart blue”, “add error handling to the function”).

blocks.text: • 现场编辑:用户可以直接编辑文物， Agent可以观察和回应
blocks.originalExcerpt: • In-place editing: Users can directly edit the artifact, and the agent can observe and respond

blocks.text: • 版本历史:艺术保持订正历史，使回滚回任何先前状态。
blocks.originalExcerpt: • Version history: Artifacts maintain a revision history, enabling rollback to any prior state.

blocks.text: • 多工型工作空间:高级执行支持多个同时进行
blocks.originalExcerpt: • Multi-artifact workspaces: Advanced implementations support multiple simultaneous

blocks.text: 文物(例如，一个代码文件、其测试套件和一页文件)。
blocks.originalExcerpt: artifacts (e.g., a code file, its test suite, and a documentation page).

blocks.text: 画布范式特别适合共同创作的任务:写作，编码，数据分析和设计，其中输出是文件或文物而不是对话的答案。
blocks.originalExcerpt: The canvas paradigm is particularly well-suited to co-creation tasks: writing, coding, data analysis, and design, where the output is a document or artifact rather than a conversational answer.

信任并不是一个特征 — — 它是系统的一种新兴财产，它一贯如预期的那样行事，清晰地解释自己，并从失败中优雅地恢复。 Agent UI必须作为头等大事以信任的方式设计。
blocks.originalExcerpt: Trust is not a feature—it is an emergent property of a system that consistently behaves as expected, explains itself clearly, and recovers gracefully from failures. Agentic UIs must be designed with trust as a first-class concern.

blocks.originalExcerpt: • Uncertainty quantification: Explicit statements of confidence, with the factors driving

blocks.text: 1. 范式选择事项:适当的UI范式(聊天、画布、工作流程、破折号-)

blocks.text: 2. 透明度是不容谈判的:用户不能相信他们看不到的东西。
blocks.originalExcerpt: 2. Transparency is non-negotiable: Users cannot trust what they cannot see. Thought display,

blocks.text: 工具可视化，而上下文面板不是可选的特性——它们是可信赖的Agent系统的基础。
blocks.originalExcerpt: tool visualization, and context panels are not optional features—they are the foundation of trustworthy agentic systems.

blocks.text: 3. 流线是基线:用户期望看到Agent实时工作。
blocks.originalExcerpt: 3. Streaming is the baseline: Users expect to see agents work in real time. Token streaming,

blocks.text: tool calling流线，多剂调用是表吸能力。
